Operational request/evidence-ID and constraint assertions are separately inventoried, not architecture location citations; no operational precision score inferred.
denominatorRules.ambiguity: Generic entry locator sets establish topic relevance only. Pooled claim-completeness records independently assess stated claim support. No claim that every generic pointer supports every associated claim. Ambiguous andinexact records remain denominator failures.
denominatorRules.operational: Explicit REA evidence IDs are included as typed operational citations and independently verified. Other execution/boundary assertions lacking source-artifact citation are explicitly inventoried for separate operational review,not silently scored as verified.

comparison.observedOnly: A exceeds B by16architecture points; C exceeds B by14; A exceeds C by2. This is one target and bounded static recovery; no generalized conventional-tool/REA effectiveness or real-model quality inference.
comparison.citationCaution: Do not compare raw precision ratios as coverage. B states more unknowns and makes fewer claims. Supplemental generic locator correctness uses topical relevance,while report associated claims use support at location.
